decisions.reason: The required first-mint ticket exception is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The required first-mint commission exception is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The one-off absence of a Mint #1 affiliate commission does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning or wallet access behavior.
The first-mint commission exception does not change the Transak provider, payment conversion, accepted methods, or automatic mint flow.
Affiliate allocation for Mint #1 does not alter the ETH payment asset, swap method, output target, or shortfall behavior.
The commission exception does not change the required USDC payment and mint-execution flow.
The first-mint affiliate exception does not change how excess ETH value must be returned to the payer.
The source decision does not change payment-method disclosure, selectable wallet currencies, or card-option availability.
The one-off commission exception is independent of optional tipping controls and tip transaction behavior.
Mint #1 remains a successful mint even though it awards no commission or ticket, so the successful-mint recording rule is unchanged.
The FAQ currently states that all no-referral mints allocate rewards randomly and that every primary mint pays an affiliate; the accepted Mint #1 exception makes both statements overbroad.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yeah, that’s fine, since it’s a one-off and won’t have any impact going forward.

value_updates.referral_operation: Explain that each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code, successful referred mints award $5 plus Small Block tickets, and no-referral mints allocate the commission and Small Block tickets to a random existing NFT holder, except Mint #1 awards neither when no earlier NFT holder exists.
value_updates.single_level_and_founder_share: Explain that referrals are single-level, source is verified on Basescan, and each $15 primary mint normally allocates $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool, except no affiliate commission is awarded for Mint #1 when no earlier NFT holder exists.

decisions.reason: The first-mint commission exception does not alter success-modal timing, token-ID accuracy, or follow-up transaction controls.
